[[The Skullflayer]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[staff]] dropped by [[Waray Skullflayer]], a [[boss]] in [[Sparkfly Swamp]].

==Stats==
:[[Energy]] +15
:[[Chaos damage]]: 11-22 (Requires 9 [[Illusion Magic]])
:Halves skill recharge of [[spell]]s (Chance: 20%)
:Halves casting time of [[Illusion Magic]] [[spell]]s (Chance: 20%)
:[[Health]] +30

==Skin==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Arcane Staff]], however, its colors are slightly different.
